g.title: MarieRank4Convo6 begins.
g.text: MarieRank4Convo6 begins.

g.title: j3023286837
g.text: Check boolean LyonIndifference1

g.title: j3301517485
g.text: Drifter ? Do you have a moment ? I must speak with you about Lyon...

g.title: j3023286837->j3301517485
g.text: true

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j3023286837->Chat ends.
g.text: false

g.title: j1531216646
g.text: Check boolean DrifterLyon

g.title: j1736719142
g.text: He's an adult. He can decide when he wants to talk.

g.title: j1531216646->j1736719142
g.text: true

g.title: j1531216646->j1736719142
g.text: false

g.title: j1429589159
g.text: My heart is breaking to see him going through this pain. I don't know how to help him.

g.title: j1531216646->j1429589159
g.text: true

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j1531216646->j242691715
g.text: true

g.title: j1531216646->j242691715
g.text: false

g.title: j1678204925
g.text: I don't know how to help him.

g.title: j1531216646->j1678204925
g.text: false

g.title: j4009517550
g.text: When you were trapped in this world of your making, caught in an endless cycle of death, did you have help to escape ?

g.title: j3621808135
g.text: Oui, and it is painful to watch him suffer... Especially now knowing how you have made room in your heart for him.

g.title: j901018774
g.text: It is a hard thing, to predict where the borders may be with him. They often shift from day to day.

g.title: j2960855332
g.text: None of their help would have been worth anything if I didn't want to be helped.

g.title: j68161685
g.text: I did, from friends.

g.title: j69657961
g.text: I have seen him struggle with the agonies the gods have heaped upon his shoulders. I have known when to be silent at his side, or when to be the proverbial wall upon which he may pound his fists.

g.title: j3462959195
g.text: I don't think Lyon wants my help.

g.title: j1870027423
g.text: I'm trying to be here for him, but he's not listening.

g.title: j658453695
g.text: Mais ça ? This ? This place, the words of the devil, the uncertainty that le Cardinal has caused... This has brought him pain from which I pray he can return.

g.title: j4004220335
g.text: Then I suppose... there is nothing left to do but be patient, non ?

g.title: j2427060347
g.text: Nor to myself, which is why I have come to discuss this with you. I have always been able to console him -

g.title: j658387046
g.text: So you admit that Entrati has hurt Lyon? And how does this sit with you?

g.title: j94797225
g.text: I feel like he's teetering on the brink. How do I help pull him back?

g.title: j2998410057
g.text: Merci. I am sorry to waste your time.

g.title: j3096917512
g.text: I find myself taken aback at his rage, his désespoir... he shuns my company in a way that he never has before.

g.title: j168965323
g.text: Pas bien... But how am I meant to choose between my love for my brother and my adoration for le Cardinal ? How must I choose between my famille ?

g.title: j2167195269
g.text: I do not know, which is why I have come to discuss this with you. I have always been able to console him -

g.title: j1111008101
g.text: What has troubled him so ? Do you know the cause ?

g.title: j3317846290
g.text: You don't have to choose, Marie. People can be complicated in the way they exist in our lives.

g.title: j89518548
g.text: I would choose the family who is still here. Not the one who left you.

g.title: j1611607060
g.text: I'm sure Entrati didn't want to cause Lyon this kind of pain.

g.title: j4280533004
g.text: You could choose a new family. Like me. And those around you who care, without Entrati.

g.title: j2411453274
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j1123264325
g.text: That's the problem with people like Entrati. They're not just forces for "Good" or "Bad." They're a mix.

g.title: j896396377
g.text: Let us keep this talk of le Cardinal away from this conversation, oui ? I am concerned for the brother of my soul.

g.title: j2359123534
g.text: I do not think he did either, but the fact of it remains, oui ? But I appreciate your sentiment. Cela dit...

g.title: j3017146389
g.text: Boolean DrifterMarie is now true.

g.title: j95304696
g.text: Lyon is trying to come to terms with the fact that the Indifference isn't a real god.

g.title: j2411453274->j95304696
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMITW

g.title: j3364109049
g.text: I don't think it's just one thing that's causing it. I think it's being caught between a great many things.

g.title: j2411453274->j3364109049
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMITW

g.title: j2411453274->j3364109049
g.text: LyonRell3

g.title: j2411453274->j3364109049
g.text: LyonRoathe3

g.title: j2411453274->j3364109049
g.text: LyonEntrati3

g.title: j2411453274->j3364109049
g.text: LyonRell1

g.title: j4025875235
g.text: Lyon was hearing the voice of one of the Tenno, a kid named Rell. Rell... died. I don't think he's coping well with this.

g.title: j2411453274->j4025875235
g.text: LyonRell3

g.title: j3418586826
g.text: He has Roathe whispering lies to him about the Man in the Wall.

g.title: j2411453274->j3418586826
g.text: LyonRoathe3

g.title: j980207681
g.text: I don't imagine having Entrati whispering to him that the voices of his gods are actually the voices from the Void helped.

g.title: j2411453274->j980207681
g.text: LyonEntrati3

g.title: j3209246286
g.text: I honestly don't, no.

g.title: j2411453274->j3209246286
g.text: false

g.title: j1455167933
g.text: Let us keep this talk of le Cardinal away from this conversation, oui ? I am concerned for the brother of my soul. But... I know what you say is... more and more becoming the clear truth.

g.title: j2662837213
g.text: Do not think I do not see what you did, sneaking yourself in there first, wolf.

g.title: j3899031098
g.text: And you have been no help in these matters, if you talk to him in such a way. Even if one's words are truth, one must be careful how they are delivered.

g.title: j1020929832
g.text: Oui, he has been a shelter in the storm for so many... and now he is caught in one himself.

g.title: j515080323
g.text: I have heard him speak that name, Rell - and it breaks my heart to know of the boy's fate.

g.title: j722182476
g.text: That devil has caused more woe in his long life than so many ! But I do not think it is the only cause of his strife, non ?

g.title: j397089088
g.text: S'il te plaît, no more talk of le Cardinal. I do not deny that his words add to Lyon's strife, but it cannot be the only cause.

g.title: j4277721414
g.text: Then I suppose... all we can do is be patient and hope that we discover what troubles him.

g.title: j3790667277
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati4a is now true.

g.title: j1213826615
g.text: Surgery is not best performed with an axe. This is not the Brittanic Navy.

g.title: j633655241
g.text: Torn from all sides, and not knowing which way to go...

g.title: j2400252586
g.text: But I do not think it is the only cause of his strife ? Lyon follows the path of Lua. La mort est une compagne qui marche à ses côtés.

g.title: j279773239
g.text: It has aided his uncertainty... But to put that much value into the words of a devil ? My Lyon knows better than that. I think it has been many things that now weigh him down.

g.title: j453562948
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati4b is now true.

g.title: j2036447444
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j1597537659
g.text: Non, I think it has been many things that now weigh him down.

g.title: j2494964703
g.text: We have to be his shelter, then. A place he knows won't hurt him.

g.title: j3700551535
g.text: We need to show him the way back to safety, then. Be the light in the darkness.

g.title: j1829084554
g.text: I guess... we need to show him the way back to safety, then. Be the light in the darkness.

g.title: j2014841563
g.text: I guess then... we just have to be his shelter. A place he knows won't hurt him.

g.title: j4018541517
g.text: He did not place enough weight in le Cardinal's words to let it pitch him into such darkness. I think it has been many things that now weigh him down.

g.title: j1951140113
g.text: Merci. I know you are trying your best. And for this, I am grateful.

g.title: j1072034689
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1442222610
g.text: How do you aid someone who cannot hear your call, cannot see your light ? Non, Lua has shrouded him in this darkness.

g.title: j3970171871
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2422613864
g.text: Oui, I suppose you are right. We must be those that he can turn to, when all else fails him.

g.title: j948087490
g.text: I do not think even the light of Sol could pierce the veil.

g.title: j3721968427
g.text: Where his faith may be infirm, we must be the ground beneath his feet.

g.title: j2130095258
g.text: If all the unseen voices have turned from welcome fantômes to démons in the shadows that plague him -

g.title: j975051374
g.text: We must make ourselves all the more real, non ?

g.title: j4028203498
g.text: I'll keep trying.

g.title: j2234375503
g.text: I just hope this doesn't tear him apart.

g.title: j1846813452
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j278471647
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1941493417
g.text: That is all we can do, in the end.

g.title: j2729598985
g.text: Oui... as do I. But all we can do is stand beside him and pray, non ?

g.title: j1804009780
g.text: Try. And pray.

g.title: j3869104411
g.text: And hope it is not too late.

g.title: j3805454251
g.text: Merci... I must go. I am sorry if this conversation was not of much use. I fret when I cannot act.

g.title: j2137653439
g.text: I'm the same way. But sometimes, action is the wrong choice.

g.title: j2828732707
g.text: He'll be all right. I'm sure of it.

g.title: j3377626561
g.text: I pray you are correct. I do not know what I would do without him.
